# Owasidea

> Owasidea is a polyglot desktop app framework. Rust, Go, TypeScript, C#, C, and
> C++ plugins compile to WASI Component Model modules described by WIT. A Rust
> Wasmtime host enforces manifests and capabilities; a Tauri 2 shell provides
> the desktop app; webview UI plugins are isolated static bundles.

## Start here

- [Get Started](docs/GET_STARTED.md): full human walkthrough from install to Tauri bundle.
- [Get Started pt-BR](docs/GET_STARTED.pt-BR.md): guia em português.
- [AI agent playbook](docs/AI_AGENTS.md): deterministic commands, invariants, API, acceptance checks.
- [Windows support](docs/WINDOWS.md): native Windows flow, NSIS packaging, cross-compilation limits.
- [AppImage packaging](docs/APPIMAGE.md): linuxdeploy root cause, clean CI build, optional local workaround.
- [Updater](docs/UPDATER.md): Tauri updater, latest.json, stable/beta channels, local static-server test.
- [Release](docs/RELEASE.md): gates, profiles, signing keys, CI secrets, publish/rollback.
- [Clean build environments](docs/CLEAN_BUILD.md): bubblewrap isolation for AppImage, plus Arch devtools/Debian debootstrap chroots without Docker.
- [Reference app](examples/shipyard/README.md): real six-language app with isolated Svelte/React UI and Tauri packaging.
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): host, runtime, manifests, capability broker.
- [CLI](docs/CLI.md): commands and flags.
- [HTTP API](docs/API.md): endpoints and JSON call contract.
- [Plugin authoring](docs/PLUGIN_AUTHORING.md): language-specific build outputs.
- [UI plugins](docs/UI_PLUGINS.md): static bundles and sandboxing.
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): trust boundaries and production policy.

## Reference commands

```bash
cargo install --path crates/cli
cd examples/shipyard
owasidea build
owasidea test
owasidea dev
owasidea bundle
```

## Invariants

- Manifests are generated from real WIT; never hand-edit them.
- Headless plugins are WASI components; `js-wasm` is webview-only.
- Permissions are deny-by-default and least-privilege.
- Tauri bundles include manifests and component `.wasm` files only.
